_readme: Azure RBAC role -> severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low/Info) for the Azure Roles tables, drawer tabs, and drilldowns. Critical is reserved for roles that directly control the Entra tenant; subscription Owner and Azure RBAC administrators control Azure resources and are High. Two key styles: "Role" (applies to all scopes) and "Role@ScopeType" (scope-specific override). ScopeType in: Subscription, Resource group, Resource, Management group, Root, Scope. Roles not listed (e.g. custom roles) render as Info until you rate them. '_'-prefixed keys are comments. Modify freely per tenant.
